reviews.title: Another beautiful Lian Li case
reviews.comment: Fantastic case. Having built in the two previous versions of the O11 Dynamic Line, I had high expectations. The Evo was already a marked improvement over the original O11, but the Vision changed the game with the addition of a new glass panel on the top. Slightly less airflow, and you can't top mount a radiator if you use the glass panel, but you have both options available. Build quality was impressive as usual from Lian Li, and even with less airflow with the top pane, there was still more than enough to keep everything running cool. Plenty of room inside the main chamber for all of my parts, and plenty of cable management space in the back chamber. Just make sure all of the bottom cables on the mobo are properly arranged if you are using fans on the bottom of the case. It is definitely a larger case for fitting into a workspace but definitely worth making the room for it.
reviews.author: Ignacio Tomas

reviews.title: Sleek, Spacious, and Built for Performance!
reviews.comment: The Lian Li O11 Vision Compact Black ATX Mid Tower Case is an absolute winner for anyone looking to build a clean, modern, and well-ventilated PC. From its premium materials to its smart layout, this case makes building both effortless and visually stunning. Build Quality & Design: ✅ High-Quality Construction – The steel frame feels solid and durable, while the tempered glass panels add a premium touch. ✅ Compact Yet Spacious – Despite being a compact mid-tower, it provides plenty of room for high-end components, including large GPUs and multiple cooling options. ✅ Panoramic View – The three-sided tempered glass design makes this case perfect for showcasing your build, especially with RGB lighting. Cooling & Airflow: ✅ Great Ventilation – The airflow is surprisingly good, thanks to well-placed vents and the option for multiple fan and radiator configurations. ✅ Customizable Cooling Options – Supports liquid cooling and high-performance air cooling with ease. Ease of Building & Features: ✅ Easy Cable Management – The back-connect motherboard support makes routing cables much cleaner, resulting in a clutter-free build. ✅ Tool-Free Installation – Installing components is quick and hassle-free with the tool-less design. A Few Things to Consider: ⚠️ Cable Routing Needs Planning – The compact design means that cable management requires some extra effort to keep everything neat. ⚠️ Limited Front I/O – The front ports are minimal, so if you need a lot of front-facing connectivity, you might need a hub. Final Verdict: If you're looking for a stylish, well-built, and feature-packed case that makes your PC look incredible while keeping it cool, this is the one to get. The tempered glass panels make it a showpiece, and the smart layout ensures excellent performance and easy upgrades. Highly recommended for anyone wanting a clean and high-end build experience.
reviews.author: Wolf Girls Tavern

reviews.title: A pleasure to build in.
reviews.comment: Wow this case was a joy to build with. I don’t think it says in the description but this case was a collaboration with Lian Li and the PCmasterrace subreddit and it shows that people with a lot of PC building experience had a hand in this. There are just so many quality of life things engineered into the case, I was amazed at how easy it was to install every component without fighting the case in any way. The cable management in the back is a dream as well with all the built in tie downs available it was easy to get everything nice and tidy. The airflow is great with how I have my fans set up, and there are a ton of options for fan location to account for many different preferences and needs. Build quality of the case is exceptional, and it comes with screws and hardware to mount anything you could possibly want to in the case. The only tiny gripe I have is that the SDD mount on the swinging door inside the back of the case didn’t have enough clearance for the SATA cable to plug into the drive on the mount, but was easy enough to attach it to one of the HDD cages nearby. Very happy with the purchase and I’ll be hard pressed to buy a case from another brand going forward.

reviews.author: DonovanRamos

reviews.title: The devil is in the details, and Lian Li thought of the details
reviews.comment: Best case I've ever built with. Airflow is good. 7800x3D idles at 40 degrees. I appreciate the little things that this case provides and I never even knew I needed. Pros: - You can strip just about every panel off the case which gives you all the room you need to maneuver and route wires - Bottom and side radiator/fan brackets come out so you can mount your fans to the bracket and install all at once. Especially convenient on the bottom if you need to wire something on your mobo after the fans have been installed. No need to remove each fan individually to get back there. - Tons of room in the case, both in the front compartment and rear. - Hard drive cages allow you to secure the drives outside the case and then install with a single thumbscrew. - PSU mount is in the vertical center instead of the bottom so you don't have to run all cables the exact same way and cause a traffic jam. - Swinging gate on the back holds your wires in place and allows you to mount HDDs and hubs on the outer wall. - Grommets keep things looking clean - Everything fits tightly, provides good airflow, and assembles with the minimum amount of screws necessary while still feeling sturdy and secure - Glass is so clear it's easy to think it's not there. Cons: - GPU anti-sag bracket is a good idea but if you have a triple fan GPU, the bracket will interfere with your third fan. If you're not using it, it's just in the way. I will be removing the bracket.
